title: Full Stack Developer
card_description: Pre-filled with optimized power words for both frontend and backend engineering, matching top ATS requirements.
description: This entry-level Full Stack template is structurally built to prove you understand both database routing and frontend user interfaces, even if you do not have years of corporate experience. It is designed to aggressively target keywords surrounding both client-side rendering and server-side logic in a single fluid narrative.
core_philosophy: A lot of freshers fail because they just list 'HTML' and 'React' in a giant list without explaining how they interact. This template avoids that trap completely. It guides you to prove exactly how you connected a RESTful API to a responsive frontend in your academic projects. By structuring your college assignments like enterprise software architecture, you bypass automated resume scanners instantly. We focus heavily on separating the View from the Controller logically on the page.
ats_optimizations: Hardcoded to trigger explicit keyword hits for RESTful APIs, JSON Web Tokens, and modern JavaScript environments like Next.js or React.
Strategically places the Academic Projects section above Professional Experience to hide non-technical employment gaps from aggressive HR filters.
Embeds explicit GitHub link structures naturally designed for technical recruiter scanning software to scrape portfolio data instantly.
Replaces generic 'Developed an app' phrasing with 'Architected a full-stack CRUD application,' mirroring senior-level documentation standards.

title: Data Analyst
card_description: Packed with actionable verbs and data translation keywords designed strictly to bypass initial automated screenings.
description: This Data Analyst resume structure focuses entirely on how you pull, clean, and visualize data to solve actual business problems rather than just blindly naming software tools. It positions you as a strategic thinker rather than a pure script executor.
core_philosophy: Corporate recruiters do not care that you know how to open Excel. They specifically care that you can use Excel and SQL to save a company money. This template forces you to write your college assignments in a way that highlights ROI (Return on Investment) and actionable reports. By tying specific SQL join queries to measurable business outcomes, you prove you understand the underlying commercial value of big data.
ats_optimizations: Strategically weaves SQL join types (INNER, LEFT) and aggregate functions into the project summaries to hit deep-level technical requirements.
Categorizes tools perfectly into Data Visualization, Database Management, and Scripting sections so robotic parsers never get confused.
Prioritizes measurable impact figures (e.g., 'Reduced processing time by 20%') over vague, unquantifiable responsibilities.
Highlights A/B testing methodologies which are frequently missing from junior resumes but heavily demanded by modern marketing teams.

title: Data Engineer
card_description: Features optimal vocabulary for ETL pipelines, big data integration, and data warehousing to stand out to recruiter AIs.
description: A heavy-duty layout mapped perfectly for students who want to show they understand deep-level data pipelines, massive warehousing arrays, and highly scalable cloud infrastructure without needing senior credentials.
core_philosophy: Big data jobs look for reliability above all else. This template cuts out the frontend fluff and centers your entire profile around how you move millions of rows of data efficiently from Point A to Point B without breaking the system. It guides you to explain your data normalization tactics and how you structured batch processing algorithms inside your academic or personal projects.
ats_optimizations: Highlights essential cloud-native terminology like Data Lakes, Serverless Computing, and Distributed Systems to bypass enterprise IT scanners.
Ensures programming languages (like Python or Scala) sit directly adjacent to big data processing frameworks so parsing bots link the two concepts.
Formats technical academic projects to look exactly like real-world enterprise infrastructure builds, utilizing raw data injection phrasing.
Strips away non-relevant UI/UX keywords to concentrate 100% of the keyword density on backend data integration and scaling.

title: Software Engineer
card_description: Standardized, cleanly formatted generic engineering templates filled with algorithmic problem-solving and SDLC buzzwords.
description: The classic, ultra-clean backend engineering template. It relies entirely on standard industry formatting to highlight core computer science logic, complex data structures, and algorithmic optimization projects.
core_philosophy: You absolutely do not need crazy colors, progress bars, or complicated designs to land a software job. In fact, clean text parsing gets the absolute best results. This template uses simple, sharp formatting to push your Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) projects directly to the top. It demands that you explain the Big O time complexity of your code and how you optimized loops, framing you as a highly analytical thinker.
ats_optimizations: Contains zero images, progress bars, or complex tables, ensuring a 100% perfect parse rate on brutal legacy systems like Workday and Taleo.
Splits programming languages away from software environments for much easier algorithmic reading during the initial bot scan.
Promotes rigorous unit testing, continuous integration, and deep-level debugging skills natively inside the academic bullet points.
Highlights memory management and execution speed optimizations to prove fundamental computer science competency.

title: Data Scientist
card_description: Highlight your statistical modeling, machine learning, and data visualization expertise using verified industry phrasing.
description: A highly specialized framework engineered to show hiring managers you understand both the deep theoretical mathematics of modeling and exactly how to put those models into live production environments.
core_philosophy: Data science is an incredibly crowded field right now. This specific resume layout proves you are not just running a basic linear regression script and calling it a day. Instead, it forces you to walk through the actual model accuracy metrics (like F1 scores or RMSE) and real-world deployment challenges. It bridges the gap between raw academia and corporate product engineering.
ats_optimizations: Balances machine learning terms carefully with foundational statistical forecasting words to satisfy both HR and Lead Engineering scanners.
Highlights data preparation and missing value handling alongside model tuning to show a comprehensive full-stack data approach.
Formats GitHub, Google Colab, and Kaggle profile links so ATS bots register them correctly as valid external portfolio artifacts.
Prioritizes feature engineering narratives over simple algorithm name-dropping, demonstrating deep domain knowledge.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
card_description: Targeted ATS templates packed with power words for model deployment, NLP, deep learning, and MLOps.
description: This ML engineering template shifts the focus slightly away from raw data science and pushes much harder into the actual code deployment, endpoint structuring, and MLOps architecture.
core_philosophy: An ML Engineer needs to build models that actually run without crashing the cloud. This layout pushes you to highlight the specific frameworks you used to deploy your academic models via APIs or Docker containers. It shows recruiters you are ready to manage production clusters and understand inferencing speed, rather than just building models in a vacuum.
ats_optimizations: Front-loads neural network architectures and deep learning framework keywords to hit high-tier specialization filters.
Validates your cloud platform integration skills directly next to your modeling projects to satisfy cross-disciplinary requirements.
Structures bullet points to show exact model accuracy improvements over time, emphasizing a highly iterative development process.
Injects specific MLOps terminology that is rarely found on junior resumes, instantly elevating your profile's authority score.

title: Business Analyst
card_description: Communicate stakeholder engagement, requirement gathering, and process optimization strictly in ATS-friendly language.
description: The ultimate narrative template for bridging the massive gap between deep technical data structuring and actual human business communication. Highly optimized for heavily regulated industries like banking, healthcare, and corporate IT.
core_philosophy: Business Analysts are hired to talk to both humans and computers seamlessly. This template ensures your hard technical skills (like SQL querying and Excel macros) are tied directly to leadership words like 'Stakeholder Communication' and 'Requirements Gathering'. It proves that you can translate confusing technical bottlenecks into actionable executive summaries.
ats_optimizations: Injects Agile and Scrum methodology language heavily throughout the document to trigger mandatory project management sweeps.
Groups mapping and visualization tools closely together to hit standard BA keyword density checks used by Fortune 500 banks.
Forces a clean, highly readable layout that strongly appeals to non-technical HR managers while keeping enough tech terms for the IT directors.
Highlights cross-functional team coordination, proving your ability to lead without formal authority.

title: AI Engineer / GenAI
card_description: Modernized templates with prompt engineering, LLM integration, and generative AI keywords formatted for robots.
description: A radically cutting-edge GenAI layout explicitly tailored for the rapidly evolving 2026 job market. It is engineered to prove you understand prompt optimization, complex RAG architectures, and Large Language Model fine-tuning.
core_philosophy: Because GenAI engineering is incredibly new, traditional software engineering resumes look completely out of place when applying for it. This one is purpose-built to let you showcase your API payload integrations, vector database semantic searches, and LLM temperature tuning without sounding like you are just throwing buzzwords against a wall.
ats_optimizations: Packed densely with newly added 2026 ATS keywords dealing specifically with generative tech and latent space methodologies.
Highlights vector databases and embedding logic naturally within standard software pipelines to prove architectural competence.
Clearly separates foundational ML knowledge from modern generative API skills so recruiters can verify your technological timeline.
Emphasizes cost-reduction techniques in API calling, which is the number one priority for startups hiring AI engineers.

title: Cloud Engineer
card_description: Pre-populated with essential power phrases for AWS/Azure/GCP architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code.
description: A heavy network-focused resume template meticulously designed to bypass basic junior IT support requirements and prove you can handle highly scalable, secure web infrastructure.
core_philosophy: Cloud recruiters absolutely want to see high-tier security protocols and automated deployment pipelines. This template walks you through proving you know exactly how to host a server, secure the network ports, and automate the entire deployment process. You will achieve this simply by framing your standard academic coursework as enterprise-grade cloud deployments.
ats_optimizations: Clusters Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) automation tools directly next to major cloud platform names to trigger exact-match parameters.
Features a highly dedicated block for cloud computing certifications (like AWS Cloud Practitioner) which are mandatory for many automated ATS gateways.
Highlights deep Linux administration and basic bash scripting organically within project descriptions.
Frames simple university web-hosting projects as 'High-Availability Cloud Architecture Implementations' to maximize authority.

title: Power BI Developer
card_description: Purpose-built for BI specialists who need to prove dashboard design, DAX mastery, and enterprise data modeling skills to ATS systems.
description: This Power BI Developer resume template is engineered to position you as a full business intelligence professional — not just a 'dashboard builder.' It proves you can own the entire data pipeline from raw source connection through transformation to executive-level visual storytelling, making you stand out in both technical and non-technical hiring panels.
core_philosophy: Most Power BI resumes are dead on arrival because they just list tool names. Recruiters and ATS systems in 2026 are looking for outcome-driven language: 'Reduced monthly reporting cycle from 5 days to 4 hours' beats 'Experienced with Power BI' every single time. This template forces you to frame every project around a measurable business result — turning your academic or freelance dashboards into enterprise-grade case studies. We also heavily emphasize the separation between Power Query (ETL), DAX (calculation), and Report Design (UX) to showcase your full-stack BI competency.
ats_optimizations: Structures skills into three distinct categories — Data Modeling, DAX/M Language, and Visualization — so ATS parsers correctly register deep BI specialization rather than generic analytics.
Injects Power Platform ecosystem keywords (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) which are increasingly mandatory for enterprise Microsoft environment roles.
Formats project descriptions to highlight Row-Level Security (RLS) and incremental refresh configurations — advanced keywords rarely found on junior BI resumes.
Includes explicit mention of data source connectors (Azure Synapse, SharePoint, SQL Server) to satisfy both cloud-native and on-premise enterprise job filters.
